usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and Mitto sends the text when “New Task Created in Project” runs “Send an SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Send an SMS” in Mitto
bestTemplate.why: A new task texts one recipient, sent through your Mitto account, so urgent work is seen quickly.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so the text follows a scheduled check, not the task itself.
